WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        (CAST(SUBSTRING(mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 2016) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTRING(mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS ts
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    ts,
    qty AS actual_2018
FROM base_data
WHERE ts >= 25 AND ts <= 36
ORDER BY product_id, ts
